listing.name: TheDarkSix - Ship & Weapons Pack (EN Translation)
listing.summary: My poor second translation attempt of a great CN super ship mod.
listing.aiSummary: Adds super dreadnoughts, fighters, weapons, and hullmods for core factions, along with reskinned ship systems.

description: Adds super dreadnoughts for all core factions plus XIV and LG. Includes new fighters, weapons, and hullmods, as well as normal ships for all factions and a unique Atlas variant for Pirates. Features reskins of existing ship systems.
